name: Kosaka Makoto
source:
A female teacher, known as the “Steel Virgin” by her students. She is the assistant head of her grade.

She has a cool attitude toward her students and her classes. Her classes are strict and stifling, but she also has a surprising side to her, as when she waters her flowerbeds by herself.

She is currently having an affair with a man who has a wife and child.

[From [url=http://www.love-juice.jp/takeout/new_kyousi.htm]official site[/url]]
